Answer: F
Reason: The pre-operative chest X-ray (Figure 1a) demonstrates a large right-sided mediastinal mass causing significant mass effect, including displacement of the trachea to the left and compression/shift of the cardiac silhouette. The post-operative image (Figure 1c) shows resolution of the mass with return of the trachea and mediastinal structures to their normal midline alignment, confirming that both heart and tracheal displacement were corrected by the excision.
